instruction: Solve 3-mode linear buckling of a 96x96x1.2 mm Steel shell with S4R/6 mm mesh, simply supported U3 edges, rigid-body constraints, and per-node +/-7.2/3.6 N edge compression.
init: none; config uploads no files and launches Abaqus/CAE 2025LE
failure_reason: Current GT passes artifact, Buckle step/3 eigenvalues, Steel shell section with 1.2 mm and 5 integration points, 96x96 geometry, S4R/6 mm mesh, and set checks, then fails the first BC direct-attribute signature. Real-CAE inspection confirms six DisplacementBC objects and native keyword blocks for four edge U3 constraints, center U1/U2, and bottom-mid U1. It also confirms 34 ConcentratedForce objects and native Cload lines with +3.6/+7.2 N on 17 left-edge nodes and -3.6/-7.2 N on 17 right-edge nodes. Reopened BC/load objects expose none of createStepName/u*/cf1 directly. Although eval defines a later keyword validator, its control flow returns immediately on direct BC failure and never reaches it, so the valid native model cannot pass.

real_software_generation.method: Opened the exact staged Job-Buckle-A.cae in the GUI and task-specifically inspected all BC/load objects plus synchronized native Boundary/Cload blocks, confirming every instructed constraint and all 34 tributary nodal forces. No replacement was written because current eval exits before its own keyword validator.
